checks.name: A fresh garage has a rusty starter car, zero premium systems and six finite courses
Only unlocked tracks and affordable garage upgrades can be selected
Engine, tyres and body all change driving and each upgrade respects its cost and cap
A race counts down before accelerating and rejects purchases or course changes while moving
Steering direction and off-road friction matter without leaving finite road bounds
Nitro uses a finite tank and actually accelerates the car
Holding drift on a straight or at rest does not farm rewards
A well-timed curve needs correct steering and a section can reward only one drift entry
A real rival impact slows the car, grants brief protection and bodywork softens the impact
Holding drift too early or pressing late can drift but cannot earn a perfect timing bonus
Equivalent frame rates preserve time, distance and speed
Invalid delta times and malformed inputs never produce non-finite progress
Finishing by legal driving awards once, unlocks progress and preserves it through garage and reload
Corrupt or hostile saves recover to a safe finite garage
